recipe.name: P1 Windshield sunrise
recipe.hook_formula: Second person, present tense: put the reader in the driver's seat at dawn, then the strongest fact.
recipe.image_prompt_template: View through a truck windshield at {time_of_day} on an open {road} highway, no text, no logos, no lettering
recipe.motion_template: Slow push-in down the highway as the light rises

en.primary_text: You and your co-driver hit the road and earn $2,500 per week, paid every week. Class A team positions are open now. Join our team.
en.headline: Team drivers, apply today.

es.primary_text: Usted y su compañero salen a la ruta y ganan $2,500 por semana, con pago semanal. Posiciones de equipo Clase A disponibles ahora. Únanse al equipo.
es.headline: Conductores en equipo, únanse.

en.hook: Sun's up. You get paid weekly.
en.primary_text: Every week a new sunrise through the windshield — and a paycheck waiting. Team Class A drivers earn $2,500 per week with weekly pay. Apply today and keep the wheels turning.
en.headline: Team Class A — $2,500/week.

es.primary_text: Cada semana un amanecer desde la cabina y un pago puntual. Conductores en equipo Clase A ganan $2,500 por semana con pago semanal. Aplique hoy y mantenga las ruedas girando.
es.headline: Equipo Clase A — $2,500/semana.

en.primary_text: You are behind the wheel at dawn, your partner is rested, and your pay — $2,500 every week — hits your account on schedule. Class A CDL required. Apply and ride with a team.
en.headline: Class A teams earn $2,500/wk.

es.primary_text: Usted conduce al amanecer, su compañero descansado está listo, y su pago — $2,500 cada semana — llega puntual. Se requiere CDL Clase A. Aplique y maneje en equipo.
es.headline: Equipos Clase A: $2,500/semana.
